subject: Re: MAP — POC activation sequence and peering timeline
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & POC kickoff — network and keys questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move the evaluation into a short POC. Before we lock dates, we need to confirm a few infrastructure items so our security team can run the checklist:

1) API keys and org setup: will we be creating a dedicated Acme org on Redwood or will you provision scoped API keys against an existing org?
2) IP allowlist: we have strict outbound policies; we need the egress IPs for the MAP environment and an expected CIDR for peering config.
3) VPC peering: our infra team prefers peering over public IPs when possible — what support do you have for cross-account VPC peering and route tables?

Can you send a proposed activation sequence and an estimated timeline for these items? We hope to start the POC the week of June 7 if possible.

Attached is a short network worksheet (acme-network-worksheet.xlsx) with contact points for our cloud team.

Best,
Sana
Head of ML Engineering, Acme Health

From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & POC kickoff — network and keys questions

Hi Sana — great to hear and glad the demo landed well. Below is a concise activation sequence we use for MAP-driven POCs; I included owners and an optimistic timeline to meet your target of starting the week of June 7.

Activation sequence (owners + target days):
- Day 0 (Redwood): Create a dedicated Acme evaluation org and seed org-level roles. Owner: michael_grant@redwood.ai.
- Day 1 (Redwood->Acme): Provision scoped API keys (short-lived test keys + a long-lived read-only key for metrics). Deliverable: api-keys.txt (staged). Owner: marissa_cole@redwood.ai.
- Day 2 (Acme infra): Apply IP allowlist entries for outbound calls to Redwood hosted endpoints. We will provide 3 stable egress IPs and a backup range. Owner: Tom Rivers / Acme infra.
- Day 3 (Joint): Optional VPC peering or private link setup (if Acme prefers). We provide a VPC peering template and route guidance; expect 1–3 business days depending on change window. Owner: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai and Acme cloud team.
- Day 4 (Joint): Smoke tests — token exchange, simple generate/embeddings calls, and latency spot checks. Owner: Acme + Redwood devops.
- Day 5 (Acme): Sign-off and begin evaluation workloads.

Notes and caveats:
- If you need air-gapped peering/workflows, we can provide a private deployment estimate; that would add procurement time (typically 4–6 weeks).
- We normally deliver an "activation checklist" PDF that lists the exact firewall rules, peering CIDRs, and API header expectations; attaching a draft now (redwood-map-activation-checklist.pdf).

I copied Marissa (implementation lead) and Neha (solutions/infrastructure) so they can coordinate any technical questions directly with Tom. If this sequence works, I can lock calendar slots and produce a one-page MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & POC kickoff — network and keys questions

Neha / team — quick coordination note before we hand off to Acme infra:

- I will generate the scoped API keys and upload a secure link (temporary) to Drive. Keys: one test key (30d expiry) + one metrics-only key. I will not email keys in the clear.
- Neha, can you please attach the peering template and a short runbook for route table entries? Include BGP/ASN details if they request cross-account peering.
- Ops ask: confirm whether Acme wants AWS VPC peering (us-east-1) or a PrivateLink endpoint. We have a template for both; peering needs a CIDR check on both sides.

I'll plan to send the Drive link and the activation checklist by EOD Tuesday (May 25). Michael — if you confirm the June 7 start date we should reserve a preflight slot June 4 for the smoke tests.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & POC kickoff — network and keys questions

Thanks — confirmation from our infra side: June 4 preflight window works and we will target June 7 for the POC start. A few quick clarifications:

- Please send the egress IPs and the exact port list (we allow 443 outbound only but need the destination IPs).
- We'll take the VPC peering template; our networking lead prefers peering but will evaluate PrivateLink if it reduces config changes.
- Send the Drive link for keys to the mailbox ops+acme@acmehealth.com and mark the link as expiring in 7 days.

We appreciate the clear sequence — please include acceptance criteria in the MAP (latency < 120ms p95 for generation baseline, embeddings under 60ms).

Tom Rivers
Cloud Infrastructure, Acme Health
